extracted.intended_audience: authors, illustrators, and award committee members involved with Pura Belpré Award submissions
extracted.subtask_description: Terms, definitions, and evaluative criteria for selecting Pura Belpré Award medalists (one Latino author and one Latino illustrator) for outstanding children's books and picture books that portray the Latino cultural experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award categories and purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Two medals shall be awarded annually ... one to a Latino author of an outstanding children’s book and one to a Latino illustrator for creating an outstanding children’s picture book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each must be an original work that portrays, affirms and celebrates the Latino cultural experience. Honor books may be named. If suitable candidates are not found, the awards will not be presented in that year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication requirements (place and timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: The award-winning books must be published in the United States or Puerto Rico during the preceding year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: "Published in the preceding year" means the book has a publication date in the year under consideration, was available for purchase in that year, and has a copyright date no later than that year. An eligible book may have a copyright date prior to the year under consideration if it was not published until the year under consideration. The intent: that every eligible book be considered, but that no book be considered in more than one year. "Children’s books 'published in the United States or Puerto Rico' means that books originally published in other countries are not eligible."

rubrics_metrics.name: Recipient residency/citizenship
rubrics_metrics.description: Recipients of the Pura Belpré medal must be residents or citizens of the United States or Puerto Rico.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For purposes of residency, 'resident' specifies that author has established and maintained residence in the United States, or Puerto Rico, as distinct from being a casual or occasional visitor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language and format eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiction and nonfiction books for children published in Spanish, English, or bilingual formats are eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes all forms of writing—fiction, non-fiction, and poetry—that have the Latino cultural experience as a theme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality and exclusions (reprints/compilations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each of these must be an original work ... Reprints and compilations are not eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In defining 'original work,' the committee may consider books that are traditional in origin, if the book is the result of original research and the retelling and interpretation are the writer's own.

rubrics_metrics.name: Co-author / co-illustrator eligibility and posthumous awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Author may include co-authors. The author(s) may be awarded the medal posthumously. In the case where the co-author is not of Latino heritage, the book is ineligible for consideration. Illustrator may include co-illustrators. The artist(s) may be awarded the medal posthumously. In the case where the co-illustrator is not of Latino heritage, the book is ineligible for consideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One person may be selected to receive the awards in both categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'Latino' for eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: For purposes of this award, 'Latino' is defined as people whose heritage emanates from any of the Spanish-speaking cultures of the Western Hemisphere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of committee consideration (only eligible books)
rubrics_metrics.description: The committee in its deliberations is to consider only the books eligible for the award, as specified in the terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This specifies that the committee is not to consider the entire body of work by an author or whether the author has previously won the award. The committee's decision is to be made following deliberation about eligible books published in the preceding year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'children's book' (audience and respect)
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'children's book' shall be a book for which children are an intended potential audience. The book must display respect for children’s understandings, abilities and appreciations. Children are defined as persons of ages up to and including 14, and books for this entire age range are to be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'children's picture book'
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'children's picture book' ... is one that essentially provides the child with a visual experience. A picture book has a collective unity of story line, theme, or concept, developed through the series of pictures of which the book is comprised.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The only limitation to graphic form is that the form must be one which may be used in a picture book.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'Outstanding'
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Outstanding' is defined as: marked by eminence and distinction; noted for significant achievement; marked by excellence in quality; marked by conspicuous excellence or eminence; individually distinct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpretation of the theme or concept (text criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Interpretation of the theme or concept
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In identifying the author of an 'outstanding' book for children, the committee should look for an accurate and positive portrayal of the Latino culture and consider interpretation of the theme or concept among other literary elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation of information (text criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Presentation of information including accuracy, clarity, and organization
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Committee should evaluate how information is presented for children, including factual accuracy and clarity of organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development of a plot (text criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Development of a plot
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider plot development appropriate to intended child audience and the book's theme; note that not all books will have a traditional plot (e.g., concept books, poetry).

rubrics_metrics.name: Delineation of characters (text criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Delineation of characters
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess clarity and distinctiveness of characters and how they contribute to the book's portrayal of Latino cultural experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delineation of setting (text criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Delineation of setting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate how setting is portrayed and how it supports theme, character, and cultural authenticity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriateness of style (text criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appropriateness of style
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge whether the writing style suits the intended child audience and the book's concept; stylistic excellence need not appear in every element but the book should have distinguished qualities in all pertinent elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence of presentation for intended child audience (text criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Excellence of presentation for an intended child audience
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The committee should keep in mind that the award is for both literary quality and presentation for children; presentation should respect children's understandings, abilities and appreciations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary weight on text (text selection process guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: In considering a book, the committee is to make its decision primarily on the text. Other aspects of a book are to be considered only if they distract from the text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such other aspects might include illustrations, overall design of the book, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-contained requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The book must be a self-contained entity, not dependent on other media (i.e., digital, sound or film equipment) for its enjoyment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated for both text and picture book categories; a submission dependent on external media is ineligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural authenticity for text
rubrics_metrics.description: Particular attention will be paid to cultural authenticity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Committee should look for an accurate and positive portrayal of the Latino cultural experience; award is for literary quality and portrayal of the Latino cultural experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence of execution in artistic technique (illustration criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Excellence of execution in the artistic technique employed
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate technical mastery and execution appropriate to the illustrative medium used in the picture book.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pictorial interpretation of story, theme, or concept (illustration criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Excellence of pictorial interpretation of story, theme, or concept
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess how effectively the pictures interpret and advance the story, theme, or concept.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriateness of illustration style
rubrics_metrics.description: Appropriateness of style of illustration to the story, theme or concept
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge whether illustration style suits and enhances the book's story, theme, or concept for a child audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delineation through pictures (illustration criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Delineation of plot, theme, characters, setting mood or information through the pictures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess how well illustrations convey narrative, thematic, character, setting, mood, or informational content without relying solely on text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positive and authentic portrayal of Latino culture (illustration criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Positive and authentic portrayal of Latino culture
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Particular attention will be paid to cultural authenticity; illustrations should present Latino culture positively and authentically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence of presentation for intended child audience (illustration criterion)
rubrics_metrics.description: Excellence of presentation for an intended child audience
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The award is for both distinguished illustrations in picture books and for excellence of pictorial presentation for children; consider how illustrations engage and serve children.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary weight on illustrations (illustration selection process guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each book is to be considered as a picture book. The committee is to make its decision primarily on the illustrations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Other components of a book (e.g., written text, overall design) are to be considered especially when they make a book less effective as a children's picture book.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graphic form limitation (illustration form constraint)
rubrics_metrics.description: The only limitation to graphic form is that the form must be one which may be used in a picture book.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection statement guidance (avoid unsupported generalities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Note: Speak only to the terms, criteria, and definitions for this award. Avoid generalities such as, 'This is a nice book'; 'The illustrations are appropriate,' etc., without supporting critical analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Committee statements and evaluations should reference the award's defined criteria and provide supporting critical analysis rather than unsupported praise.
